COL api_keys.id bigint null=NO default=nextval('api_keys_id_seq'::regclass)
COL api_keys.prefix text null=YES
COL api_keys.hash bytea null=YES
COL api_keys.user_id bigint null=YES
COL api_keys.created_at timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL api_keys.expiration timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL api_keys.last_seen timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL database_versions.id bigint null=NO default=nextval('database_versions_id_seq'::regclass)
COL database_versions.version text null=NO
COL database_versions.updated_at timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL migrations.id character varying len=255 null=NO
COL node_shares.id bigint null=NO default=nextval('node_shares_id_seq'::regclass)
COL node_shares.node_id bigint null=NO
COL node_shares.user_id bigint null=NO
COL node_shares.created_by bigint null=YES
COL node_shares.created_at timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL nodes.id bigint null=NO default=nextval('nodes_id_seq'::regclass)
COL nodes.machine_key text null=YES
COL nodes.node_key text null=YES
COL nodes.disco_key text null=YES
COL nodes.endpoints text null=YES
COL nodes.host_info text null=YES
COL nodes.ipv4 text null=YES
COL nodes.ipv6 text null=YES
COL nodes.hostname text null=YES
COL nodes.given_name character varying len=63 null=YES
COL nodes.user_id bigint null=YES
COL nodes.register_method text null=YES
COL nodes.tags text null=YES
COL nodes.auth_key_id bigint null=YES
COL nodes.expiry timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL nodes.last_seen timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL nodes.approved_routes text null=YES
COL nodes.created_at timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL nodes.updated_at timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL nodes.deleted_at timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL nodes.approved_at timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL oauth_access_tokens.id bigint null=NO default=nextval('oauth_access_tokens_id_seq'::regclass)
COL oauth_access_tokens.prefix text null=YES
COL oauth_access_tokens.hash bytea null=YES
COL oauth_access_tokens.client_id text null=YES
COL oauth_access_tokens.scopes text null=YES
COL oauth_access_tokens.tags text null=YES
COL oauth_access_tokens.expiration timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL oauth_access_tokens.created_at timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL oauth_clients.id bigint null=NO default=nextval('oauth_clients_id_seq'::regclass)
COL oauth_clients.client_id text null=YES
COL oauth_clients.secret_hash bytea null=YES
COL oauth_clients.scopes text null=YES
COL oauth_clients.tags text null=YES
COL oauth_clients.description text null=YES
COL oauth_clients.user_id bigint null=YES
COL oauth_clients.created_at timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL oauth_clients.revoked timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL policies.id bigint null=NO default=nextval('policies_id_seq'::regclass)
COL policies.created_at timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL policies.updated_at timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL policies.deleted_at timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL policies.data text null=YES
COL pre_auth_keys.id bigint null=NO default=nextval('pre_auth_keys_id_seq'::regclass)
COL pre_auth_keys.key text null=YES
COL pre_auth_keys.prefix text null=YES
COL pre_auth_keys.hash bytea null=YES
COL pre_auth_keys.user_id bigint null=YES
COL pre_auth_keys.description text null=YES

COL pre_auth_keys.ephemeral boolean null=YES default=false
COL pre_auth_keys.used boolean null=YES default=false

COL pre_auth_keys.expiration timestamp with time zone null=YES

COL pre_auth_keys.preauthorized boolean null=YES default=true
COL settings.key text null=NO
COL settings.value text null=YES
COL settings.updated_at timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL users.id bigint null=NO default=nextval('users_id_seq'::regclass)
COL users.created_at timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL users.updated_at timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL users.deleted_at timestamp with time zone null=YES
COL users.name text null=YES
COL users.display_name text null=YES
COL users.email text null=YES
COL users.provider_identifier text null=YES

COL users.profile_pic_url text null=YES
COL users.role text null=YES
COL users.approved_at timestamp with time zone null=YES
IDX CREATE INDEX idx_policies_deleted_at ON public.policies USING btree (deleted_at)
IDX CREATE INDEX idx_users_deleted_at ON public.users USING btree (deleted_at)
IDX CREATE UNIQUE INDEX api_keys_pkey ON public.api_keys USING btree (id)
IDX CREATE UNIQUE INDEX database_versions_pkey ON public.database_versions USING btree (id)
IDX CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_api_keys_prefix ON public.api_keys USING btree (prefix)
IDX CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_name_no_provider_identifier ON public.users USING btree (name) WHERE (provider_identifier IS NULL)
IDX CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_name_provider_identifier ON public.users USING btree (name, provider_identifier)
IDX CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_node_shares_node_user ON public.node_shares USING btree (node_id, user_id)
IDX CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_oauth_access_tokens_prefix ON public.oauth_access_tokens USING btree (prefix)
IDX CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_oauth_clients_client_id ON public.oauth_clients USING btree (client_id)
IDX CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_pre_auth_keys_prefix ON public.pre_auth_keys USING btree (prefix) WHERE ((prefix IS NOT NULL) AND (prefix <> ''::text))
IDX CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_provider_identifier ON public.users USING btree (provider_identifier) WHERE (provider_identifier IS NOT NULL)
IDX CREATE UNIQUE INDEX migrations_pkey ON public.migrations USING btree (id)
IDX CREATE UNIQUE INDEX node_shares_pkey ON public.node_shares USING btree (id)
IDX CREATE UNIQUE INDEX nodes_pkey ON public.nodes USING btree (id)
IDX CREATE UNIQUE INDEX oauth_access_tokens_pkey ON public.oauth_access_tokens USING btree (id)
IDX CREATE UNIQUE INDEX oauth_clients_pkey ON public.oauth_clients USING btree (id)
IDX CREATE UNIQUE INDEX policies_pkey ON public.policies USING btree (id)
IDX CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pre_auth_keys_pkey ON public.pre_auth_keys USING btree (id)
IDX CREATE UNIQUE INDEX settings_pkey ON public.settings USING btree (key)
IDX CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_pkey ON public.users USING btree (id)
CON api_keys api_keys_id_not_null NOT NULL id
CON api_keys api_keys_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
CON database_versions database_versions_id_not_null NOT NULL id
CON database_versions database_versions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
CON database_versions database_versions_version_not_null NOT NULL version
CON migrations migrations_id_not_null NOT NULL id
CON migrations migrations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
CON node_shares fk_node_shares_node FOREIGN KEY (node_id) REFERENCES nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CON node_shares fk_node_shares_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CON node_shares node_shares_id_not_null NOT NULL id
CON node_shares node_shares_node_id_not_null NOT NULL node_id
CON node_shares node_shares_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
CON node_shares node_shares_user_id_not_null NOT NULL user_id
CON nodes fk_nodes_auth_key FOREIGN KEY (auth_key_id) REFERENCES pre_auth_keys(id)
CON nodes fk_nodes_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CON nodes nodes_id_not_null NOT NULL id
CON nodes nodes_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
CON oauth_access_tokens oauth_access_tokens_id_not_null NOT NULL id
CON oauth_access_tokens oauth_access_tokens_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
CON oauth_clients oauth_clients_id_not_null NOT NULL id
CON oauth_clients oauth_clients_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
CON policies policies_id_not_null NOT NULL id
CON policies policies_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
CON pre_auth_keys fk_pre_auth_keys_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
CON pre_auth_keys pre_auth_keys_id_not_null NOT NULL id
CON pre_auth_keys pre_auth_keys_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
CON settings settings_key_not_null NOT NULL key
CON settings settings_pkey PRIMARY KEY (key)
CON users users_id_not_null NOT NULL id
CON users users_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
